by: Blind reader, from the synthetic STEP 7 LAD editor screenshot build-records/figure/10-two-conveyors/conveyors.png, never seeing a builder file
doubts: Both networks' left rails share the single pin name POWER.t; since every pin may appear in only one net, I merged both rails' connections into one power net (N1 I0.0, N1 Q4.0 seal-in branch, N2 Q4.0).
I0.1 is drawn as a normally open contact -| |- even though the comment says the Stop button is normally closed (reads 1 until pressed); I read it as kind 'no', exactly as drawn.
The TON box's PT input (T#5S) and ET output (MD20) are values, not pins, and are left out of the nets; the box's printed instance operand is DB1, read as the ton's key.
The seal-in branch joins the main rung at x~200 px with a plain T-junction; no joint dots are drawn anywhere, so every net is dotted: false.
Positions measured from dark-pixel extents on the 900x640 image: contacts by their two bars, coils by their two arcs, the TON by its box outline (x 359-480, y 355-452).
